name: Gin
description: A juniper-forward spirit redistilled with a mix of botanicals — citrus peel, coriander, angelica, orris and more. London dry is the dominant style, but genever, old tom, Plymouth and modern botanical-led gins all fall under the umbrella. The backbone of the Martini, Negroni and Tom Collins, and a player in tiki from the 20th Century to the Singapore Sling.
